dn4:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Aṅgesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhu-saṃghena saddhiṃ pañca-mattehi bhikkhu-satehi yena Campā tad avasari.
dn4:1.3: Tatra sudaṃ Bhagavā Campāyaṃ viharati Gaggarāya Pok kharaṇiyā tīre.
dn4:1.4: Tena kho pana samayena Soṇadaṇḍo Brāhmaṇo Campaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rāja-bhoggaṃ raññā Māgadhena Seniyena Bimbisārena dinnaṃ rāja-dāyaṃ brahma-deyyaṃ. 2.
dn4:2.2: ‘Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Sakya-putto Sakya-kulā pabbajito Aṅgesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṃghena saddhiṃ pañca-mattehi bhikkhu-satehi Campaṃ anuppatto Campāyaṃ viharati Gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
dn4:2.3: Taṃ kho pana Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
dn4:2.4: "Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho vijjā-caraṇa-sampanno sugato loka-vidū anuttaro purisa-damma-sārathī satthā deva-manussānaṃ buddho bhagavā."
dn4:2.5: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇa-brāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadeva-manussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
dn4:2.6: So dhammaṃ deseti ādi-kalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosāna-kalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ , kevala-paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
dn4:2.7: Sādhu kho pana tathā-rūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.'
dn4:2.8: Atha kho Campeyyakā brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā Campāyaṃ nikkhamitvā saṃghā saṃghī gaṇī-bhūtā yena Gaggarā pokkharaṇī ten' upasaṃkamanti. 3.
dn4:3.1: Tena kho pana samayena Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo uparipāsāde divā-seyyaṃ upagato hoti.
dn4:3.2: Addasā kho Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo Campeyyake brāhmaṇa-gahapatike Campāya nikkhamitvā saṃghā saṃghī gaṇī-bhūte yena Gaggarā pokkharaṇī ten' upasaṃkamante.
dn4:3.4: ‘Kin nu kho bho khatte Campeyyakā brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā Campāya nikkhamitvā saṃghā saṃghī gaṇi-bhūtā yena Gaggarā pokkharaṇī ten' upasaṃkamantīti?'
dn4:3.5: ‘Atthi samaṇo Gotamo Sakya-putto Sakya-kulā pabbajito. Aṅgesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhu-saṃghena saddhiṃ pañca-mattehi bhikkhu-satehi Campaṃ anuppatto Campāyaṃ viharati Gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
dn4:3.6: Taṃ kho pana Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
dn4:3.7: "Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjā-caraṇa-sampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisa-damma-sārathī satthā deva-manussānaṃ buddho bhagavā ti."
dn4:3.8: Tam ete bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamantīti.'
dn4:3.9: ‘Tena hi bho khatte yena Campeyyakā brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā ten' upasaṃkama, upasaṃkamitvā Campeyyake brāhmaṇa-gahapatike evaṃ vadehi;
dn4:3.11: "Āgamentu kira bhavanto, Soṇadaṇḍo pi brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissatīti."'
dn4:3.12: ‘Evaṃ bho' ti kho so khattā Soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā yena Campeyyakā brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Campeyyake brāhmaṇa-gahapatike etad avoca:
dn4:3.14: "Āgamentu kira bhavanto, Soṇadaṇḍo pi brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissatīti."' 4.
dn4:4.1: Tena kho pana samayena nānā-verajjakānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ pañca-mattāni brāhmaṇa-satāni Campāyaṃ paṭivasanti kenacid eva karaṇīyena.
dn4:4.3: ‘Soṇadaṇḍo kira brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissatīti.'
dn4:4.4: Atha kho te brāhmaṇā yena Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā Soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn4:4.5: "Saccaṃ kira bhavaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissatīti?'
dn4:4.7: aham pi samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissāmīti .'
dn4:5.1: ‘Mā bhavaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkami,
dn4:5.2: na arahati bhavaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ.
dn4:5.3: Sace bhavaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissati, bhoto Soṇadaṇḍassa yaso hāyissati, samaṇassa Gotamassa yaso abhivaḍḍhissati.
dn4:5.4: Yam pi bhoto Soṇadaṇḍassa yaso hāyissati samaṇassa Gotamassa yaso abhivaḍḍhissati, iminā p' aṅgena na arahati bhavaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ,
dn4:5.5: samaṇo tveva Gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ Soṇadaṇḍaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ. Bhavaṃ
dn4:5.6: hi Soṇadaṇḍo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddha-gahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahā-yugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jāti-vādena.
dn4:5.7: Yam pi bhavaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito saṃsuddha-gahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahā-yugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena, iminā p' aṅgena na arahati bhavaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ,
dn4:5.8: samaṇo tveva Gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ Soṇadaṇḍam dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ. Bhavaṃ
dn4:5.9: hi Soṇadaṇḍo aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo . . . pe . . .
dn4:5.10: Bhavaṃ hi Soṇadaṇḍo ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkhara-ppabhedānaṃ itihāsa-pañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyata-mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇesu anavayo. Bhavaṃ
dn4:5.11: hi Soṇadaṇḍo abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇa-pokkharatāya samannāgato brahma-vaṇṇī brahma-vaccasī akkhuddāvakāso dassanāya. Bhavaṃ
dn4:5.12: hi Soṇadaṇḍo sīlavā vuddha-sīlī vuddha-sīlena samannāgato. Bhavaṃ
dn4:5.13: hi Soṇadaṇḍo kalyāṇa-vāco kalyāṇa- vākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya aneḷagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā. Bhavaṃ
dn4:5.14: hi Soṇadaṇḍo bahunnaṃ ācariya-pācariyo tīṇi māṇavaka-satāni mante vāceti, bahū kho pana nānā-disā nānā-janapadā māṇavakā āgacchanti bhoto Soṇadaṇḍassa santike mantatthikā mante adhiyitukāmā. Bhavaṃ
dn4:5.15: hi Soṇadaṇḍo jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto,
dn4:5.16: samaṇo Gotamo taruṇo c' eva taruṇa-paribbājako ca. Bhavaṃ
dn4:5.17: hi Soṇadaṇḍo rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito. Bhavaṃ
dn4:5.18: hi Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇassa Pokkharasādissa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito. Bhavaṃ
dn4:5.19: hi Soṇadaṇḍo Campaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rāja-bhoggaṃ raññā Māgadhena Seniyena Bimbisārena dinnaṃ rāja-dāyaṃ brahma-deyyaṃ.
dn4:5.20: Yam pi bhavaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo Campaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rāja-bhoggaṃ raññā Māgadhena Seniyena Bimbisārena dinnaṃ rāja-dāyaṃ brahma-deyyam,
dn4:5.21: iminā p' aṅgena na arahati bhavaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ,
dn4:5.22: samaṇo tveva Gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ Soṇadaṇḍaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamitun ti.' 6.
dn4:6.1: Evaṃ vutte Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo te brāhmaṇe etad avoca:
dn4:6.2: ‘Tena hi bho mama pi suṇātha, yathā mayam eva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ,
dn4:6.3: na tv' eva arahati so bhavaṃ Gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ.
dn4:6.4: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddha-gahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahā-yugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jāti-vādena.
dn4:6.5: Yam pi bho samaṇo Gotamo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddha-gahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahā-yugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jāti-vadena, iminā p' aṅgena na arahati so bhavaṃ Gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ,
dn4:6.6: atha kho mayam eva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ.
dn4:6.7: Samaṇo Gotamo mahantaṃ ñāti-saṃghaṃ ohāya pabbajito.
dn4:6.8: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo pahūtaṃ hirañña-suvaṇṇaṃ ohāya pabbajito bhūmi-gatañ ca vehāsaṭṭhañ ca.
dn4:6.9: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo daharo va samāno susukāḷa-keso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
dn4:6.10: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo akāmakānaṃ mātā-pitunnaṃ assu-mukhānaṃ rudantānaṃ kesa-massuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
dn4:6.11: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇa-pokkharatāya samannāgato brahma-vaṇṇī brahma-vaccasī akkhuddāvakāso dassanāya.
dn4:6.12: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo sīlavā ariya-sīlī kusala-sīlī kusala-sīlena samannāgato.
dn4:6.13: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo kalyāṇa-vāco kalyāṇa-vākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya aneḷagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā.
dn4:6.14: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo bahunnaṃ ācariya-pācariyo.
dn4:6.15: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo khīṇa-kāma-rāgo vigata-cāpallo.
dn4:6.16: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo kamma-vādī kiriya-vādī apāpa-purekkhāro brahmaññāya pajāya.
dn4:6.17: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo uccā kulā pabbajito ādīnakkhattiya-kulā.
dn4:6.18: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo aḍḍha-kulā pabbajito mahaddhanā mahā-bhogā.
dn4:6.19: Samaṇaṃ khalu bho Gotamaṃ tiro raṭṭhā tiro janapadā sampucchituṃ āgacchanti.
dn4:6.20: Samaṇaṃ khalu bho Gotamaṃ anekāni devatā-sahassāni pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gatāni.
dn4:6.21: Samaṇaṃ khalu bho Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
dn4:6.22: "Iti pi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇa-sampanno sugato loka-vidū anuttaro purisa-dammasārathī satthā deva-manussānaṃ buddho bhagavā ti."
dn4:6.23: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo dvattiṃsa-mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇehi samannāgato.
dn4:6.24: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo ehisāgata-vādī sakhilo sammodako abbhākuṭiko uttānamukho pubba-bhāsī.
dn4:6.25: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo catunnaṃ parisānaṃ sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito.
dn4:6.26: Samaṇe khalu bho Gotame bahū devā manussā ca abhippasannā.
dn4:6.27: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo yasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā paṭivasati na tasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā amanussā manusse viheṭhenti.
dn4:6.28: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo saṃghī gaṇī gaṇācariyo puthu-tittha-karānaṃ aggam akkhāyati. Yathā kho pana bho ekesaṃ samaṇa-brāhmaṇānaṃ yathā vā tathā vā yaso samudāgacchati na h' evaṃ samaṇassa Gotamassa yaso samudāgato,
dn4:6.29: atha kho anuttarāya vijjā-caraṇa-sampadāya samaṇassa Gotamassa yaso samudāgato.
dn4:6.30: Samaṇaṃ khalu bho Gotamaṃ rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gato.
dn4:6.31: Samaṇaṃ khalu bho Gotamaṃ rājā Pasenadi Kosalo saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gato.
dn4:6.32: Samaṇaṃ khalu bho Gotamaṃ brāhmaṇo Pokkharasādi saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gato.
dn4:6.33: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo rañño Māgadhassa Seniyassa Bimbisārassa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito.
dn4:6.34: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo rañño Pasenadi-Kosalassa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito.
dn4:6.35: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo brāhmaṇassa Pokkharasādissa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito.
dn4:6.36: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Campaṃ anuppatto Campāyaṃ viharati Gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
dn4:6.37: Ye kho pana keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā amhākaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ āgacchanti atithī no te honti.
dn4:6.38: Atithī pi kho pan' amhehi sakkātabbā garukātabbā mānetabbā pūjetabbā apacetabbā.
dn4:6.39: Yam pi bho samaṇo Gotamo Campaṃ anuppatto Campāyaṃ viharati Gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre, atith' amhākaṃ samaṇo Gotamo.
dn4:6.40: Atithi kho pan' amhehi sakkātabbo garukātabbo mānetabbo pūjetabbo apacetabbo.
dn4:6.41: Iminā p' aṅgena na arahati so bhavaṃ Gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ,
dn4:6.42: atha kho mayam eva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ.
dn4:6.43: Ettake kho ahaṃ bho tassa bhoto Gotamassa vaṇṇe pariyāpuṇāmi, no ca kho so bhavaṃ Gotamo ettaka-vaṇṇo,
dn4:6.44: aparimāṇavaṇṇo hi so bhavaṃ Gotamo ti.' 7.
dn4:6.45: Evaṃ vutte te brāhmaṇā Soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn4:6.46: ‘Yathā kho bhavaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo samaṇassa Gotamassa vaṇṇe bhāsati ito ce pi so bhavaṃ Gotamo yojana-sate viharati alam eva saddhena kula-puttena dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ api puṭaṃsenāpi .
dn4:6.47: Tena hi bho sabbe va samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamissāmāti.'
dn4:7.1: Atha kho Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo mahatā brāhmaṇagaṇena saddhiṃ yena Gaggarā pokkharaṇī ten' upasaṃkami. 8.
dn4:8.1: Atha kho Soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa tiro-vana-saṇḍagatassa evaṃ cetasā parivitakko udapādi:
dn4:8.2: ‘Ahaṃ ce va kho pana samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ pañhaṃ puccheyyaṃ,
dn4:8.3: tatra ce maṃ samaṇo Gotamo evaṃ vadeyya:
dn4:8.4: "Na c' esa brāhmaṇa pañho evaṃ pucchitabbo, evaṃ nām' esa brāhmaṇa pañho pucchitabbo" ti tena maṃ ayaṃ parisā paribhaveyya:
dn4:8.5: "Bālo Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo avyatto, nāsakkhi samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ yoniso pañhaṃ pucchitun ti."
dn4:8.6: Yaṃ kho panāyaṃ parisā paribhaveyya yaso pi tassa hāyetha,
dn4:8.7: yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha bhogā pi tassa hāyeyyuṃ,
dn4:8.9: Maṃ ce va kho pana samaṇo Gotamo pañhaṃ puccheyya, tassa cāham pañhassa veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ na ārādheyyaṃ.
dn4:8.10: Tatra ce maṃ samaṇo Gotamo evaṃ vadeyya,
dn4:8.11: "Na c' esa brāhmaṇa pañho evaṃ vyākātabbo, evaṃ nām' esa brāhmaṇa pañho vyākātabbo" ti tena maṃ ayaṃ parisā paribhaveyya:
dn4:8.12: "Bālo Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo avyatto, nāsakkhi samaṇassa Gotamassa pañhassa veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādhetun ti."
dn4:8.13: Yaṃ kho panāyaṃ parisā paribhaveyya yaso pi tassa hāyetha,
dn4:8.14: yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha bhogā pi tassa hāyeyyuṃ,
dn4:8.16: Ahaṃ ce va kho pana evaṃ samīpa-gato samāno adisvā samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ nivatteyyaṃ tena maṃ ayaṃ parisā paribhaveyya:
dn4:8.17: "Bālo Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo avyatto mānatthaddho bhīto ca, no visahi samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ, kathaṃ hi nāma evaṃ samīpa-gato samāno adisvā samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ nivattissatīti?"
dn4:8.18: Yaṃ kho panāyaṃ parisā paribhaveyya yaso pi tassa hāyetha,
dn4:8.19: yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha bhogā pi tassa hāyeyyuṃ,
dn4:8.20: yaso-laddhā kho pan' amhākaṃ bhogā ti.' 9.
dn4:9.1: Atha kho Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
dn4:9.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn4:9.3: Campeyyakā pi kho brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā app ekacce Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, app ekacce Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, app ekacce yena Bhagavā ten' añjalim panāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, app ekacce nāma-gottaṃ sāvetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, app ekacce tuṇhī-bhūtā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. 10.
dn4:10.1: Tatra pi sudaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo bahulam anuvitakkento nisinno hoti:--
dn4:10.2: ‘Ahaṃ ce va kho pana samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ pañhaṃ puccheyyaṃ,
dn4:10.3: tatra ce maṃ samaṇo Gotamo evaṃ vadeyya:
dn4:10.4: "Na c' esa brāhmaṇa pañho evaṃ pucchitabbo, evaṃ nām' esa brāhmaṇa pañho pucchitabbo" ti tena maṃ ayaṃ parisā paribhaveyya:
dn4:10.5: "Bālo Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo avyatto, nāsakkhi samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ yoniso pañhaṃ pucchitun ti."
dn4:10.6: Yaṃ kho panāyaṃ parisā paribhaveyya yaso pi tassa hāyetha,
dn4:10.7: yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha bhogā pi tassa hāyeyyuṃ,
dn4:10.9: Maṃ ce va kho pana samaṇo Gotamo pañhaṃ puccheyya, tassa cāhaṃ pañhassa veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ na ārādheyyaṃ,
dn4:10.10: tatra ce maṃ samaṇo Gotamo evaṃ vadeyya:
dn4:10.11: "Na c' esa brāhmaṇa pañho evaṃ vyākātabbo, evaṃ nām' esa brāhmaṇa pañho vyākātabbo" ti tena maṃ ayaṃ parisā paribhaveyya:
dn4:10.12: "Bālo Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo avyatto, nāsakkhi samaṇassa Gotamassa pañhassa veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādhetun ti."
dn4:10.13: Yaṃ kho panāyaṃ parisā paribhaveyya yaso pi tassa hāyetha,
dn4:10.14: yassa pana yaso hāyetha bhogā pi tassa hāyeyyuṃ,
dn4:10.16: Aho vata maṃ samaṇo Gotamo sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ puccheyya. Addhā vat' assāhaṃ cittaṃ ārādheyyaṃ pañhassa veyyākaraṇenāti! 11.
dn4:11.1: Atha kho Bhagavato Soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa cetasā ceto-parivitakkam aññāya etad ahosi:
dn4:11.2: ‘Vihaññati kho ayaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo sakena cittena.
dn4:11.3: Yan nūnāhaṃ Soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ puccheyyan ti.'
dn4:11.4: Atha kho Bhagavā Soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avoca:
dn4:11.5: ‘Katihi pana brāhmaṇa aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpenti,
dn4:11.6: ‘Brāhmaṇo 'smīti' ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musā-vādaṃ āpajjeyyāti?' 12.
dn4:12.1: Atha kho Soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa etad ahosi:
dn4:12.2: ‘Yaṃ vata no ahosi icchitaṃ yaṃ ākaṅkhitaṃ yaṃ adhippetaṃ yaṃ adhipatthitaṃ --
dn4:12.3: "Aho vata maṃ samaṇo Gotamo sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ puccheyya, addhā vat' assāhaṃ cittaṃ ārādheyyaṃ pañhassa veyyākaraṇenāti" -- tatra maṃ samaṇo Gotamo sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ pucchati.
dn4:12.4: Addhā vat' assāhaṃ cittaṃ ārādhessāmi pañhassa veyyākaraṇenāti.' 13.
dn4:13.1: Atha kho Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo abbhunnāmetvā kāyaṃ anuviloketvā parisaṃ Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn4:13.2: ‘Pañcahi bho Gotama aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpenti,
dn4:13.3: ‘Brāhmaṇo 'smīti' ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musā-vādaṃ āpajjeyya.
dn4:13.5: Idha bho brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddha-gahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahā-yugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jāti-vādena.
dn4:13.6: Ajjhāyako hoti manta-dharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkhara-ppabhedānaṃ itihāsa-pañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyata-mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇesu anavayo.
dn4:13.7: Abhirūpo hoti dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahma-vaṇṇī brahma-vaccasī akkhuddāvakāso dassanāya.
dn4:13.9: Paṇḍito ca hoti medhāvī paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ.
dn4:13.10: Imehi kho bho Gotama pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpenti,
dn4:13.11: ‘Brāhmaṇo 'smīti' ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musā-vādaṃ āpajjeyyāti.' 14.
dn4:14.1: ‘Imesaṃ pana brāhmaṇa pañcannaṃ aṅgānaṃ sakkā ekaṃ aṅgaṃ ṭhapayitvā catuhi aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpetuṃ,
dn4:14.2: ‘Brāhmaṇo 'smīti' ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musā-vādaṃ āpajjeyyāti?'
dn4:14.4: Imesaṃ hi bho Gotama pañcannaṃ aṅgānaṃ vaṇṇaṃ ṭhapayāma.
dn4:14.6: Yato kho bho brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddha-gahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahā-yugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jāti-vādena,
dn4:14.7: ajjhāyako ca hoti manta-dharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍu-keṭubhānaṃ sākkhara-ppabhedānaṃ itihāsa-pañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyata-mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇesu anavayo,
dn4:14.8: sīlavā ca hoti vuddha-sīlī vuddha-sīlena samannāgato,
dn4:14.9: paṇḍito ca hoti medhāvī paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ --
dn4:14.10: imehi kho bho Gotama catuh' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpenti,
dn4:14.11: ‘Brāhmaṇo 'smīti' ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musā-vādaṃ āpajjeyyāti.' 15.
dn4:15.1: ‘Imesaṃ pana brāhmaṇa catunnaṃ aṅgānaṃ sakkā ekaṃ aṅgaṃ ṭhapayitvā tīhi aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpetuṃ,
dn4:15.2: "Brāhmaṇo 'smīti" ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musā-vādaṃ āpajjeyyāti?'
dn4:15.4: Imesaṃ hi bho Gotama catunnaṃ aṅgānaṃ mante ṭhapayāma .
dn4:15.6: Yato kho bho brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddha-gahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahā-yugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jāti-vādena,
dn4:15.7: sīlavā ca hoti vuddhasīlī vuddha-sīlena samannāgato,
dn4:15.8: paṇḍito ca hoti medhāvī paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ --
dn4:15.9: imehi kho bho Gotama tīh' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpenti,
dn4:15.10: "Brāhmaṇo 'smīti" ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musā-vādaṃ āpajjeyyāti.' 16.
dn4:16.1: ‘Imesaṃ pana brāhmaṇa tiṇṇaṃ aṅgānaṃ sakkā ekaṃ aṅgaṃ ṭhapayitvā dvīh' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpetuṃ,
dn4:16.2: "Brāhmaṇo 'smīti" ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musā-vādaṃ āpajjeyyāti?'
dn4:16.4: Imesaṃ hi bho Gotama tiṇṇaṃ aṅgānaṃ jātiṃ ṭhapayāma .
dn4:16.6: Yato kho bho brāhmaṇo sīlavā ca hoti vuddha-sīlī vuddhasīlena samannāgato,
dn4:16.7: paṇḍito ca hoti medhāvī paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ --
dn4:16.8: imehi kho bho Gotama dvīh' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpenti,
dn4:16.9: "Brāhmaṇo 'smīti" ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musā-vādaṃ āpajjeyyāti.' 17.
dn4:17.1: Evaṃ vutte te brāhmaṇā Soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn4:17.2: ‘Mā bhavaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo evaṃ avaca ! Mā bhavaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo evaṃ avaca !
dn4:17.3: Apavadat' eva bhavaṃ Soṇa- daṇḍo vaṇṇaṃ apavadati mante apavadati jātiṃ, ekaṅsena bhavaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo samaṇass' eva Gotamassa vādaṃ anupakkhandatīti.' 18.
dn4:18.1: Atha kho Bhagavā te brāhmaṇe etad avoca:
dn4:18.3: "Appassuto ca Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, akalyāṇa-vākkaraṇo ca Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, duppañño ca Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, na ca pahoti Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo samaṇena Gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane patimantetun ti," tiṭṭhatu Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, tumhe mayā saddhiṃ mantavho.
dn4:18.4: Sace pana tumhākaṃ brāhmaṇā evaṃ hoti:
dn4:18.5: Bahussuto ca Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, kalyāṇa-vākkaraṇo ca Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, paṇḍito ca Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, pahoti ca Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo samaṇena Gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane patimantetun ti," tiṭṭhatha tumhe, Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo mayā saddhiṃ mantetūti.' 19.
dn4:19.1: Evaṃ vutte Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn4:19.2: ‘Tiṭṭhatu bhavaṃ Gotamo, tuṇhī bhavaṃ Gotamo hotu, aham eva tesaṃ saha dhammena paṭivacanaṃ karissāmīti.'
dn4:19.3: Atha kho Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo te brāhmaṇe etad avoca:
dn4:19.4: ‘Mā bhavanto evaṃ avacuttha, mā bhavanto evaṃ avacuttha --
dn4:19.5: "Apavadat' eva bhavaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo vaṇṇaṃ apavadati mante apavadati jātiṃ, ekaṃsena bhavaṃ Soṇadaṇḍo samaṇass' eva Gotamassa vādaṃ anupakkhandatīti."
dn4:19.6: Nāhaṃ bho apavadāmi vaṇṇaṃ vā mante vā jātiṃ vā ti.' 20.
dn4:20.1: Tena kho pana samayena Soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa bhāgineyyo Aṅgako nāma māṇavako tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
dn4:20.2: Atha kho Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo te brāhmaṇe etad avoca:
dn4:20.3: ‘Passanti no bhonto imaṃ Aṅgakaṃ māṇavakaṃ amhākaṃ bhāgineyyan ti.'
dn4:20.5: ‘Aṅgako kho bho māṇavako abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇa-pokkharatāya samannāgato brahma-vaṇṇī brahma-vaccasī akkhuddāvakāso dassanāya, nāssa imissā parisāya samasamo atthi vaṇṇena ṭhapetvā samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ.
dn4:20.6: Aṅgako kho bho māṇavako ajjhāyako manta-dharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍu-keṭubhānaṃ sākkhara-ppabhedānaṃ itihāsa-pañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyata-mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇesu anavayo.
dn4:20.8: Aṅgako kho bho māṇavako ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahā-yugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jāti-vādena.
dn4:20.10: Aṅgako kho bho māṇavako pāṇam pi haneyya adinnam pi ādiyeyya paradāram pi gaccheyya musā pi bhaṇeyya majjam pi piveyya, ettha dāni bho kiṃ vaṇṇo karissati, kiṃ mantaṃ, kiṃ jāti?
dn4:20.11: Yato kho bho brāhmaṇo sīlavā ca hoti vuddha-sīlī vuddha-sīlena samannāgato,
dn4:20.12: paṇḍito ca hoti medhāvī paṭhamo vā dutiyo vā sujaṃ paggaṇhantānaṃ,
dn4:20.13: imehi kho bho dvīh' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpenti,
dn4:20.14: "Brāhmaṇo 'smīti" ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musā-vādaṃ āpajjeyyāti.' 21.
dn4:21.1: ‘Imesaṃ pana brāhmaṇa dvinnaṃ aṅgānaṃ sakkā ekaṃ aṅgaṃ ṭhapayitvā ekena aṅgena samannāgataṃ brāhmaṇaṃ paññāpetuṃ,
dn4:21.2: "Brāhmaṇo 'smīti" ca vadamāno sammā vadeyya na ca pana musā-vādaṃ āpajjeyyāti?'
dn4:21.4: Sīla-paridhotā hi bho Gotama paññā, paññā -paridhotaṃ sīlaṃ,
dn4:21.5: yattha sīlaṃ tattha paññā, yattha paññā tattha sīlaṃ,
dn4:21.7: sīla- paññāṇañ ca pana lokasmiṃ aggam akkhāyati.
dn4:21.8: Seyyathā pi bho Gotama hatthena vā hatthaṃ dhopeyya, pādena vā pādaṃ dhopeyya,
dn4:21.9: evam eva kho bho Gotama sīlaparidhotā paññā, paññā-paridhotaṃ sīlaṃ,
dn4:21.10: yattha sīlaṃ tattha paññā, yattha paññā tattha sīlaṃ,
dn4:21.12: sīla- paññāṇañ ca pana lokasmiṃ aggam akkhāyatīti.' 22.
dn4:22.1: ‘Evam etaṃ brāhmaṇa. Sīla-paridhotā hi brāhmaṇa paññā, paññā-paridhotaṃ sīlaṃ,
dn4:22.2: yattha sīlaṃ tattha paññā, yattha paññā tattha sīlaṃ,
dn4:22.12: ‘Ettaka-paramā va mayaṃ bho Gotama etasmiṃ atthe.
dn4:22.13: Sādhu vata bhavantaṃ yeva bho Gotamaṃ paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho ti.' 23.
dn4:23.1: ‘Tena hi brāhmaṇa suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmīti.'
dn4:23.2: ‘Evaṃ bho' ti kho Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo Bhagavato paccassosi.
dn4:23.4: ‘Idha brāhmaṇa Tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho . . . yathā Sāmañña-phale evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ] . . ..
dn4:23.5: Evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti.
dn4:23.6: Idam pi kho taṃ brāhmaṇa sīlaṃ. ‘ . . . pe . . .
dn4:23.11: dutiyajjhānaṃ . . . pe . . . tatiyajjhānaṃ . . . catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati . . . pe . . . ñāṇa -dassanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti . . . pe . . .
dn4:23.15: Ayaṃ kho sā brāhmaṇa paññā ti.' 24.
dn4:24.1: Evaṃ vutte Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn4:24.3: Seyyathā pi bho Gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā tela- pajjotaṃ dhāreyya: "cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti," evam eva bhotā Gotamena aneka-pariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
dn4:24.4: Esāhaṃ Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca,
dn4:24.5: upāsakam maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ.
dn4:24.6: Adhivāsetu ca me bhavaṃ Gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenāti.'
dn4:24.8: Atha kho Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo Bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
dn4:24.9: Atha kho Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā Bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi:
dn4:25.1: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇha-samayaṃ nivāsetvā patta-cīvaraṃ ādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhu-saṃghena yena Soṇadaṇḍassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn4:25.2: Atha kho Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo Buddha-pamukhaṃ bhikkhu-saṃghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
dn4:26.1: Atha kho Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onīta-patta-pāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn4:26.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca: 26.
dn4:26.3: ‘Ahañ ce va kho pana bho Gotama parisa-gato samāno āsanā vuṭṭhahitvā Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ abhivādeyyaṃ, tena maṃ sā parisā paribhaveyya.
dn4:26.4: Yaṃ kho pana sā parisā paribhaveyya yaso pi tassa hāyetha,
dn4:26.5: yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha bhogā pi tassa hāyeyyuṃ,
dn4:26.7: Ahañ ce va kho pana bho Gotama parisa-gato samāno añjaliṃ paggaṇheyyaṃ, āsanā me taṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo paccuṭṭhānaṃ dhāretu.
dn4:26.8: Ahañ ce va kho pana bho Gotama parisa-gato samāno veṭhanaṃ omuñceyyaṃ, sirasā me taṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo abhivādanaṃ dhāretu. --
dn4:26.9: Ahañ ce va kho pana bho Gotama yāna-gato samāno yānā paccorohitvā Bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ abhivādeyyaṃ, tena maṃ sā parisā paribhaveyya.
dn4:26.10: Yaṃ kho pana sā parisā paribhaveyya, yaso pi tassa hāyetha, yassa kho pana yaso hāyetha bhogā pi tassa hāyeyyuṃ,
dn4:26.12: Ahañ ce va kho pana bho Gotama yāna-gato samāno patoda-laṭṭhiṃ abbhunnāmeyyaṃ , yānā me taṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo paccorohanaṃ dhāretu.
dn4:26.13: Ahañ ce va kho pana bho Gotama yānagato samāno hatthaṃ apanāmeyyaṃ, sirasā me taṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo abhivādanaṃ dhāretūti.' 27.
dn4:27.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmīti. 1.
